description: Accept an invite token (from email or invite_project_member in local/dev). Unverified invitees must pass otp. Returns a project-scoped nv_ key once — never email it. Collaborating uses this project_id; create_project still bills the caller.

otp.description: Email OTP required when the invitee is not yet verified. Optional if already verified.

token.description: Invite token from the invitation email (or invite_project_member in local/dev).

name: accept_project_invite
title: Accept project invite
